Dharamshala — Captions & Actions
texts: 01 — Into the green ACTION Keep the frame airy; crop to emphasize greenery.
02 — Took the scenic route ACTION Straighten subtly; preserve the winding perspective.
03 — Just passing through ACTION Use a tighter crop for a candid, in-motion feel.
04 — A little pause ACTION Reduce contrast slightly; let the stillness lead.
05 — Where the water goes ACTION Emphasize the flow with a clean crop.
06 — Nature called ACTION Keep colors restrained; avoid oversaturation.
07 — No particular direction ACTION Use an off-center composition; preserve negative space.
08 — Somewhere in the hills ACTION Lift shadows gently; keep the mountain tones natural.
09 — Found my spot ACTION Crop around the focal point; remove distractions.
10 — The hillside diaries ACTION Keep as a documentary-style frame; minimal retouching.
11 — Little things, big feelings ACTION Focus on the small detail; soften competing elements.
12 — Familiar corners ACTION Use straight edges and a balanced crop.
13 — Life between the trees ACTION Frame through the foliage; preserve depth.
14 — A view worth keeping ACTION Keep horizon level and avoid heavy color grading.
15 — Mountain-side stories ACTION Give the landscape breathing room; wide crop if possible.
16 — Just being here ACTION Keep it candid; no unnecessary retouching.
17 — Lost in the clouds ACTION Lift whites carefully; keep cloud detail.
18 — Lights after life ACTION Balance highlights and shadows; retain the night mood.
19 — Until next time ACTION Use as the closing image; keep the edit understated.
